excerpt: MobiKwik is a Gurugram fintech (wallet, UPI, pay later, payment gateway) founded in 2009 and listed on the NSE and BSE since December 2024.
content:
MobiKwik, run by One MobiKwik Systems Ltd, is an Indian digital payments and financial services company. It started as a mobile wallet for recharges and bill payments and now describes itself as a digital banking platform for consumers and merchants. Inc42 reported that its revenue comes from consumer payments, buy now, pay later (BNPL) and payment gateway services, and that it launched a sound box for merchants called Vibe.

Bipin Preet Singh started MobiKwik in August 2009 and Upasana Taku joined about five months later, according to a 2016 Outlook Business profile, which describes how banks were reluctant to partner with the young company and how the first deal took nine months to close. Singh is the CEO and Taku the COO. Inc42 reported that the company joined the unicorn club in October 2021.

MobiKwik listed on 18 December 2024. Inc42 reported that the INR 572 crore IPO, entirely a fresh issue, was oversubscribed 119.38 times, and that the shares listed at INR 442.25 on the BSE and INR 440 on the NSE, a premium of about 58% over the INR 279 issue price.

The MobiKwik app is free to download; any charges for specific services, such as interest on credit products, are shown in the app and the product terms. Check those terms before using credit. This profile is put together from the company's own pages and published reporting. We have not tested the product for this page, and nothing here is paid placement.
